title: Kids' Safari Checklist
excerpt: What should children bring on safari? A practical checklist for parents.
body:
## Clothing

- Neutral colours, layers.
- A warm fleece.
- Sun hat and sunglasses.
- Comfortable shoes.

## Health

- Sunscreen and insect repellent suitable for children.
- Malaria prevention after advice from a doctor.
- A small first-aid kit.

## Entertainment

- Their own binoculars.
- A notebook to tick off animals.
- A camera.
- Books or downloaded films for long drives.

## Snacks

Familiar snacks help on long days.

## Documents

Passports and, if required, documents for travelling with minors.

See [family safari itinerary](/blog/family-safari-itinerary/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
